title: Measurement of Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Signals in Distracted Drivers
author: Gongcheng Xu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kcjcsun
materials: 20 minutes for subjects to maintain resting state.
20 minutes for subjects to perform staight driving.

steps.title: Position the Template
steps.instruction: Place the template at the corresponding positions of the PFC, MC, and OC.

steps.title: Adapt Subjects to Simulator
steps.instruction: Allow subjects 10 minutes to adapt to the driving simulator.

steps.title: Calibrate Instrument Channels
steps.instruction: Use the instrument's calibration function to ensure channels correspond exactly to the 10/10 electrode positions.

steps.title: Optimize Signal Quality
steps.instruction: Improve the signal-to-noise ratio of specific channels by adjusting the hair with a glass rod.

steps.title: Verify Signal and Rest
steps.instruction: Confirm that the signal is good and stable, then allow subjects to rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Audio Task Driving
steps.instruction: Have subjects perform straight driving with an audio task for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Vigilance Task Driving
steps.instruction: Have subjects perform straight driving with a vigilance task for 20 minutes.
